body:
### Name and Version

built from source at commit 73a43d1f6 (v0.4.0-17-g73a43d1f6), Android arm64-v8a via NDK r29, CMake flag -DGGML_VULKAN=ON.

### Operating systems

Other? (Please let us know in description)

### GGML backends

Vulkan

### Hardware

Google Pixel 10 Pro, SoC Tensor G5, GPU Imagination PowerVR DXT-48-1536.

### Models

 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Q4_K_M — official Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF on Hugging Face.

### Problem description & steps to reproduce

->  Default GPU offload (n_gpu_layers = -1) → every generated token is identical (we saw token id 0 every time) regardless of prompt  , , no crash, no error, llama_decode returns 0 every call

->  n_gpu_layers = 0 (CPU-only) → correct output

-> Setting GGML_VK_DISABLE_COOPMAT=1, GGML_VK_DISABLE_COOPMAT2=1, GGML_VK_DISABLE_COOPMAT2_DECODE_VECTOR=1, GGML_VK_DISABLE_INTEGER_DOT_PRODUCT=1 before backend init  gives correct output on GPU, and faster than CPU. 

-> Reproduction was a cusom android JNI integration, not llama-compilation directly. 



### First Bad Commit

_No response_
